change: Show every legal move for the current position; rank only coherent Stockfish candidates; keep the highlighted recommendation stable until the position changes or the player requests deeper analysis.

fullChromeRegression.command: npx playwright test --project chrome --reporter list --output test-results/ranked-full-final

scope: both colors and all legal moves including ranked and unranked labels
unchanged best move after more than four seconds idle
explicit five-second analysis and legal tactical recommendations
board source and destination preview and per-side toggles
stale-analysis cancellation, pause, resume and variation isolation
flat board, keyboard access and 200 percent text scale

limitations: Only the top coherent Stockfish candidates have comparable engine scores. Other legal moves are listed without manufactured ranks. Local headless Chrome performance is machine-specific.
